text_en: He made an altar of bronze, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide, and ten cubits high.
text_cn: 以后，他制了一座铜坛，长二十肘，宽二十肘，高十肘。

text_en: Then he made the molten sea; it was round, ten cubits from rim to rim, and five cubits high. A line of thirty cubits would encircle it completely.
text_cn: 又铸了一个铜海，从这边到那边直径十肘，作圆形，高五肘，圆周三十肘。

text_en: Under it were panels all around, each of ten cubits, surrounding the sea; there were two rows of panels, cast when it was cast.
text_cn: 铜海边缘下四周围，围绕着匏（páo）瓜形的装饰品，每肘十个，分两行，匏（páo）瓜与铜海是同时铸成的。

text_en: It stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west, three facing south, and three facing east; the sea was set on them. The hindquarters of each were toward the inside.
text_cn: 有十二只铜牛驮着铜海：三只向北，三只向西，三只向南，三只向东；铜海安放在铜牛背上，牛尾朝里。

text_en: Its thickness was a handbreadth; its rim was made like the rim of a cup, like the flower of a lily; it held three thousand baths.
text_cn: 铜海厚一掌，边如杯边，形似百合花，可容三千“巴特”。

text_en: He also made ten basins in which to wash, and set five on the right side, and five on the left. In these they were to rinse what was used for the burnt offering. The sea was for the priests to wash in.
text_cn: 他又制了十个铜盆：五个安置在右边，五个安置在左边，作为洗涤之用，洗涤作全燔祭的物品；但铜海只可为司祭作洗涤之用。

text_en: He made ten golden lampstands as prescribed, and set them in the temple, five on the south side and five on the north.
text_cn: 又照所规定的式样制了十个金灯台，放在殿内：右边五个，左边五个。

text_en: He also made ten tables and placed them in the temple, five on the right side and five on the left. And he made one hundred basins of gold.
text_cn: 又制了十张桌子，放在殿内：右边五张，左边五张。又造了一百个金碗。

text_en: He made the court of the priests, and the great court, and doors for the court; he overlaid their doors with bronze.
text_cn: 又造了司祭院与大院以及院门，门包上铜，

text_en: He set the sea at the southeast corner of the house.
text_cn: 他把铜海放在右边东南角。

text_en: And Huram made the pots, the shovels, and the basins. Thus Huram finished the work that he did for King Solomon on the house of God:
text_cn: 胡兰也制了锅、铲和盘。胡兰为撒罗满王作了一切应为上主的殿所作的工作：

text_en: the two pillars, the bowls, and the two capitals on the top of the pillars; and the two latticeworks to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the top of the pillars;
text_cn: 两根柱子，两个柱顶上的球形柱头，两个网子，──遮盖柱顶上两个球形的柱头，

text_en: the four hundred pomegranates for the two latticeworks, two rows of pomegranates for each latticework, to cover the two bowls of the capitals that were on the pillars.
text_cn: 两个网子上的四百个石榴，──每个网子有两行石榴，以遮盖柱顶上两个球形柱头，

text_en: He made the stands, the basins on the stands,
text_cn: 十个盆座及座上的十个铜盆，

text_en: the one sea, and the twelve oxen underneath it.
text_cn: 一个铜海及下面十二只铜牛，

text_en: The pots, the shovels, the forks, and all the equipment for these Huram-abi made of burnished bronze for King Solomon for the house of the Lord .
text_cn: 锅、铲、钩，以及一切用具：这一切都是胡兰阿彼用光滑的铜，给撒罗满王为上主的殿所制造的，

text_en: In the plain of the Jordan the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zeredah.
text_cn: 是王在约但平原，于稣苛特与匝尔堂之间，用胶泥模铸成的。

text_en: Solomon made all these things in great quantities, so that the weight of the bronze was not determined.
text_cn: 撒罗满所制的这一切器皿，实在众多；所用的铜，重量无法计算。

text_en: So Solomon made all the things that were in the house of God: the golden altar, the tables for the bread of the Presence,
text_cn: 以后，撒罗满又制造了上主殿内的一切用具：金坛和供饼的桌子，

text_en: the lampstands and their lamps of pure gold to burn before the inner sanctuary, as prescribed;
text_cn: 灯台和依照规例应在内殿前点的灯盏，都是用纯金制成的；

text_en: the flowers, the lamps, and the tongs, of purest gold;
text_cn: 还有花蕊、灯盏和烛剪，都是用金，即纯金制成的；

text_en: the snuffers, basins, ladles, and firepans, of pure gold. As for the entrance to the temple: the inner doors to the most holy place and the doors of the nave of the temple were of gold.
text_cn: 还有刀、碗、盘和火盘，都是纯金的。殿宇的门，即进入至圣所内里的门，以及圣殿，即正殿的门，也都是金的。
